principle: Dependencies point toward stability. A package may depend only on layers listed in its layer's mayDependOn; same-layer edges must be listed in internal. The check also requires every workspace edge to run from a more unstable package to a more stable one (instability I = Ce / (Ca + Ce), measured from source imports).

layers.purpose: Domain-neutral primitives. Stable because nothing in the workspace is allowed beneath them.
Independent feature libraries (terminal UI, MCP, code mode). They must stay usable without the model or agent stack.
Model, provider, authentication and streaming contracts plus their implementations.
The agent loop, tool calls and state transitions over the provider-neutral model contract.
Persistent, recoverable agent execution and the remote environments it runs commands in.
Wire protocol and its client/server endpoints. Independent of the model and agent stacks.
The user-facing CLI and SDK. The only composition root for runtime layers.
Evaluations that exercise the product. Nothing depends on this layer.

entryRules.reason: The agent loop depends on the provider-neutral contract, never on provider catalogs, OAuth or API adapters.
Durable execution consumes the contract and the pure utility subpaths; routing utilities through the contract entry would exceed the durable entry-graph budget.

ai.purpose: Contracts are the stable core; adapters and credential flows sit on them; the registry composes adapters; providers are data plus wiring; the facade re-exports.

durable.purpose: Identifiers, documents, entries and the execution environment contract are the stable core; session and storage implement persistence over them; the harness runs agents on top; tools and testing consume the harness.

exceptions.reason: Type-only: the shared contract names harness option and settings types that are defined beside the harness. Moving them is a public-type reorganization, not a layering fix.
Type-only: entry payloads reference CompactionReason and ToolDiagnostic, which the harness defines.

coding-agent.purpose: Headless core and shared presentation primitives sit below the user interfaces; modes and the CLI adapt them; entry files compose everything.

exceptions.reason: Extensions import the package's own public API; the virtual module must expose the same barrel the published package exports.

cycles.scope: static runtime imports (type-only and dynamic imports are excluded)

known.reason: The run lifecycle is mutually recursive: generation starts compactions and tool tasks, a compaction admits a submission, a submission starts a run, and live-state conversion appends the aborted partial. Breaking it changes the commit and recovery boundaries of an in-flight run, so it needs its own Agent Note and the durable crash-recovery suite, not a mechanical move.
